Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about your journey to a healthier, more confident smile. If you can't find your answer here, we're just a phone call away.

Appointments & General Inquiries

We highly recommend booking an appointment in advance to avoid waiting times and to ensure our specialists can dedicate ample time to your consultation. You can easily book via our Facebook Messenger or by calling our clinic directly.

A routine consultation typically takes about 30 to 45 minutes. With our appointment system, you won't have to wait long and will receive smooth, timely service.

Treatments & Comfort

We offer a comprehensive range of dental services, including Preventive Dentistry (dental examination, dental X-ray, professional cleaning), Cosmetic Dentistry (veneers, teeth whitening), Orthodontics (braces, Invisalign), Restorative Dentistry (fillings, crowns, root canal treatment), Prosthodontics (dentures, full mouth rehabilitation), Oral Surgery (dental implants, tooth extraction, bone grafting, ridge augmentation, sinus lift), Soft Tissue Laser Dental Treatment (gingivectomy, gum depigmentation, frenectomy), and Pediatric Dentistry. You can find detailed information on our Services page.

We prioritize a pain-free experience for our patients. By utilizing modern anesthetics and advanced equipment, we ensure that you are fully comfortable and experience no pain during your treatment.

You may experience mild sensitivity immediately after treatment. We use internationally certified, high-quality whitening gels that do not damage tooth enamel, and sensitivity typically subsides within a few days.

The duration ranges from 6 months to 2 years, depending on your individual dental condition. During your initial visit, our specialists will provide a detailed assessment, an accurate timeline, and preview the expected results.

Pediatric & Emergency Care

Yes. We provide gentle care so children feel comfortable and are not afraid of visiting the dentist. We recommend bringing your child for their first check-up as soon as their first tooth appears.

We make special arrangements to provide prompt treatment for dental emergencies like severe pain or broken teeth. In such situations, please call our clinic immediately for assistance.

Safety & Sterilization

Patient safety is our top priority. We strictly follow international infection control protocols using high-grade Autoclave machines and prioritize the use of disposable items, so there is no need to worry about the risk of infection.

Cost & Payment

Treatment plans vary by individual dental condition, so accurate costs can only be determined after an in-person consultation. All costs will be clearly explained before treatment begins.

For your convenience, we accept Cash, POS, and Mobile Banking including KPay, AYA, YOMA, CB, UAB, and other supported services.
